rule: A case is `train` when the first byte of sha256("<seed>:<case directory name>") is below 154 (about 60%), else `test`. The rule depends on the case's name alone, so adding a case never moves another.
seed_note: Drawn at random from 32 bits and redrawn (3 draws in all) until train held 8 or 9 of the 14 cases; the redraw looked at case counts only, before any case had been run. Cases o15 to o24 were added afterwards and assigned by the rule without a redraw. Cases moved to train by hand after exposing a gap: o29-hard-stale-remote-and-started-fix; replaced in test by a fresh harder case. Entries added to evals.json by other sessions are converted to cases and assigned to test by hand.
